Privacy Policy
Last updated: 02.06.2026

This Privacy Policy describes what data is collected when using my portfolio website, how it is processed and protected, and what rights visitors have.

If you do not agree with the terms of this Policy, please do not use the website and do not submit your personal data via contact forms.

General Information

1.1. This website is a personal developer portfolio and is used to showcase my work, experience, and to provide contact information for communication regarding potential cooperation.

1.2. “Personal data” means any information that allows, directly or indirectly, to identify an individual (for example, name, email address, links to profiles on social networks, etc.).

1.3. By using the website and/or submitting your data through forms, you confirm that you have read this Privacy Policy and agree to its terms.

Data Controller

2.1. The controller (the person determining the purposes and means of processing personal data) is the owner of the website – a private individual.

2.2. Contact for questions regarding data protection:
E-mail: shadow-ek-alex{'@'}mail.ru

What Data Is Collected

3.1. Data you provide voluntarily

When using contact forms on the website, you may provide the following data (depending on the specific form):

Name or nickname.

Email address.

Links to your profiles (GitHub, LinkedIn, Telegram, etc.).

Message text (question, project description, cooperation request, etc.).

Any other data that you choose to include in the message text.

3.2. Data collected automatically

When you visit the website, the following technical data may be collected automatically (via server logs or standard browser mechanisms):

IP address.

Date and time of the visit.

Pages you view.

Information about the browser and operating system.

Referrer (the page from which you navigated to the website).

3.3. Publication of my personal data

My personal data may be published on the website, including:

Name, surname, or nickname.

Photograph (avatar).

Contact details (e-mail, links to Telegram, GitHub, LinkedIn, etc.).

Information about professional experience, projects, and skills.

This data is published by me voluntarily solely for the purposes of self-presentation and professional communication.

Purposes of Data Processing

Your personal data may be used for the following purposes:

Responding to your messages and requests submitted via contact forms.

Discussing potential cooperation, job offers, or joint projects.

Conducting business correspondence.

Maintaining the operability and security of the website (log analysis, abuse prevention).

Improving the content and structure of the website (anonymous visit statistics, if analytics is enabled).

Legal Bases for Processing

The processing of your personal data may be carried out on the following bases:

Your voluntary consent, expressed by submitting data via contact forms or in another way.

Necessity of processing to respond to your request, conclude and/or perform a potential civil law contract (for example, freelance cooperation).

Legitimate interests of the website owner, such as maintaining operability, improving the quality of the website, protecting rights and legitimate interests.

Disclosure of Data to Third Parties

6.1. As a general rule, your personal data is not disclosed to third parties and is used only by the website owner for the purposes listed above.

6.2. Exceptions are possible in the following cases:

If required by law (requests from public authorities, court orders, etc.).

If necessary to protect my rights and legitimate interests (for example, in cases of abuse, hacking attempts, spam attacks).

If third-party services are used (for example, hosting provider, analytics services, email services) that technically process data as part of providing their services.

6.3. When third-party services are used (analytics, forms, hosting, email), data processing may also be governed by their own privacy policies.

Data Retention Periods

7.1. Personal data obtained via contact forms or by email is stored only as long as necessary to:

Respond to your message.

Conduct business correspondence.

Fulfill potential agreements.

7.2. Technical logs (server logs) are usually stored for a limited period in accordance with the hosting provider’s settings and are used to ensure the security and stability of the website.

7.3. When the purposes of processing are achieved or upon your request, data may be deleted or anonymized, unless otherwise required by law.

Data Security

8.1. I take reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect personal data from unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.

8.2. However, it is important to understand that no method of data transmission over the internet or electronic storage can be absolutely secure. I cannot guarantee absolute security but strive to minimize risks.

Your Rights

Depending on the applicable legislation, you may have the following rights regarding your personal data:

Right of access to your personal data.

Right to rectification (correction) of your data.

Right to erasure (“right to be forgotten”).

Right to restriction of processing.

Right to object to processing.

Right to data portability.

Right to withdraw your consent if the processing is based on consent.

To exercise your rights, you can contact me at the contact address provided (e-mail). Your request may require verification of your identity.

Cookies and Similar Technologies

10.1. The website may use cookies and similar technologies for:

Technical operation of the website (for example, saving settings).

Analyzing the use of the website (if analytics is enabled).

10.2. You can manage cookies through your browser settings: block them, delete them, etc. However, disabling cookies may affect the proper functioning of certain features of the website.

Links to Third-Party Resources

11.1. The website may contain links to third-party websites and services (for example, GitHub, LinkedIn, Telegram, other projects hosting my work, video platforms, demo game platforms, etc.).

11.2. I am not responsible for the content and privacy policies of third-party resources. It is recommended that you review the terms of use and privacy policies of those websites separately.

Publication of Work and Project Information

12.1. The website contains descriptions of my work, case studies, and projects (including visual materials, repository links, demos, etc.). These materials are used solely to demonstrate my professional skills.

12.2. If you are my current or former client and believe that any project description or material violates your rights or the terms of an agreement, please contact me. I am ready to review your request and, if necessary, adjust or remove the information.

Changes to the Privacy Policy

13.1. I may periodically update this Privacy Policy. The new version takes effect from the moment it is published on the website.

13.2. It is recommended to review this page from time to time to stay informed about possible changes.

Contact

If you have any questions, comments, or requests related to the processing of personal data, you can contact me:

E-mail: shadow-ek-alex{'@'}mail.ru
